write_wav — ONED io op

• 資料種類:signal → file

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.write_wav(path, x, rate=44100)(要直接呼叫實作,import dsp; dsp.write_wav(path, x, rate=44100);從台帳取用則 ops1d.get("write_wav"))

用法

> 該運算子的說明尚無譯文,以下照原文給出。

Write a float `[-1,1]` mono signal to a 16-bit PCM WAV (stdlib).

Non-finite samples raise (they would become garbage PCM).
